equipmentHairMappings.cellRule: keep when the mapped style equals the style, hide at -1, replace with any other mapped style

Group-less names resolve by leaf and class chain with no group constraint (RM-13). The native lookup returns the first compatible match in live hash order; a leaf with more than one compatible export is refused because that order is not reproduced.
Dynamic hair halves (RM-14 NCBoneSimul modes 2 and 7) are not simulated; they stay a named gap and nothing static is drawn for them.
